source_units.text: Write for children enjoying an invented read-aloud verse.
These invented details are required: The rhyme must count one copper beetle, two velvet moths, and three sleepy stars in that order.
Set the scene around a tiny nighttime parade.
Include each of these exact strings: "one copper beetle", "two velvet moths", "three sleepy stars".
